Plant 1 is equipped with influent pumps and a mechanical screen and the emergency storage lagoon
The Emergency Storage Lagoon can be used, if needed, to capture peak flows in excess of the Facility's peak design capacity of 2.35 mgd.
The Facility's secondary treatment system consists of three parallel trains of oxidation ditches with anoxic basins, followed by secondary clarifiers.
